description: This file contains tests for the functions parseExecApprovalResultText, isExecDeniedResultText, and formatExecDeniedUserMessage, which are related to parsing and handling execution approval results within an agent system.

methods.name: parseExecApprovalResultText
methods.description: Parses a string containing execution approval result text into a structured object with kind, raw, metadata, and body.

methods.name: isExecDeniedResultText
methods.description: Determines if the given text indicates a denied execution result.

methods.name: formatExecDeniedUserMessage
methods.description: Maps denial metadata in the execution result text to a user-friendly message.
